summary: Read the entire 320-line markdown conversion, including the references; the nine-page PDF has no appendix. Checked all 19 retained estimates, their source pages, outcome/arm attribution, counts and requested codebook fields; extracted PDF text for the cited result pages and inspected Figures 1 and 2. All non-null recorded statistics and their quotes match the PDF. The unresolved analysis denominators remain null rather than being inferred from degrees of freedom. The retained outcome constructs, measures, units, timing, comparison types, within_person values and directions are consistent with the described analyses, and no numerical between-arm uncertainty should be manufactured from omnibus tests, within-arm tests, or unlabeled graphics. The coverage audit found nine missing reported contrasts involving Early-AI, including the full-sample labeling comparison. Their exclusion treats unknown continued Round 2 access as an eligibility failure, whereas rule 4 includes both with_ai and after_ai output comparisons. The report does not establish continued access or removal: preserve these contrasts and their printed statistics while leaving the uncertain availability/question classification explicitly unresolved for adjudication. No separate novelty, usefulness or originality pairwise effects are reported; their omnibus tests, self-reports, moderation, pilot ratings and fixed-order within-arm tests were appropriately not assigned to randomized two-arm estimates.
